snippet.title: Disposable Corps: Most Authentic Trench Warfare - Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
Disposable Corps: Most Authentic Trench Warfare is a tactical low-poly 5v5 FPS/TPS set in the WW1-era but with Steampunk Mechs! Build artillery, dig trenches and tunnels, command your squad, and blow up the environment!

Demo coming May 16th on Steam!

Wishlist and Follow: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3579070/Disposable_Corps/ 

Join our Discord server: https://discord.gg/vtDYcDt8yN

#fps #gaming #games #wargaming #ww1 #steam
